places-segment-juli-cruz-pata-ccaje-tiwa.story: A 243 km round trip from Juli - roughly 4 h 11 in the saddle. On the way it passes Segment Arbolera-Parcco Chua Chua, Tiwanaku: Spiritual and Political Centre o and back through Segment Arbolera-Parcco Chua Chua. The highest point is about 4,050 m. It crosses from Peru into Bolivia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
